title: Specter: Fast MoE Inference via Quantization-Enabled Multi-Step Speculative Offloading
abstract: arXiv:2511.14102v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Mixture-of-experts (MoE) models often exceed a single accelerator's memory capacity. Offloading experts to host memory creates a severe PCIe I/O bottleneck because data-dependent routing keeps transfers on the critical path. We present Specter, an inference system that uses quantization to combine speculative decoding with expert offloading. Its lightweight quantized draft model runs efficiently on device while preserving high-fidelity expert activation patterns. This provides accurate multi-step lookahead over future expert usage, allowing the runtime to organize expert movement and execution ahead of verification and improve both communication and execution efficiency. Under single-request inference, Specter achieves an average 1.50x (up to 1.88x) speedup in time per output token (TPOT) over the state-of-the-art system. translated_title: Specter：通过量化使能的多步投机卸载实现快速MoE推理
translated_abstract: 混合专家模型通常超出单个加速器的内存容量。将专家卸载到主机内存会造成严重的PCIe I/O瓶颈，因为数据依赖的路由使数据传输处于关键路径上。我们提出了Specter，一个利用量化将投机解码与专家卸载相结合的推理系统。其轻量级量化草稿模型在设备上高效运行，同时保持高保真度的专家激活模式。这为未来的专家使用提供了准确的多步前瞻，使运行时能够在验证之前提前组织专家的移动和执行，从而同时提高通信和执行效率。在单请求推理下，Specter在每输出令牌时间（TPOT）方面相比最先进的系统实现了平均1.50倍（最高1.88倍）的加速。Specter使内存受限的单GPU MoE推理在商用硬件上更加实用。
tldr: Specter通过量化使能的多步投机解码与专家卸载相结合，在单GPU上实现了平均1.50倍（最高1.88倍）的MoE推理加速。
en_tdlr: Specter combines speculative decoding with expert offloading via quantization, achieving an average 1.50x speedup for memory-constrained single-GPU MoE inference.
